title: Lab Network — MSU faculty × lab protocols × membrane outreach
context: Kevin Mok has an existing faculty network at Michigan State University. Each lab protocol (Paper 138) maps to a specific person who can validate it. The connections are not hypothetical — they are based on reproduced papers, existing relationships, and prior interactions.

He IS the quorum sensing expert. The experiment tests whether biofilm inflection occurs at 1/π of carrying capacity — this is directly in his domain.

lab_to_faculty.approach: share Paper 138 + LAB-001 protocol. the prediction (inflection at 1/π of K) is novel and testable with his existing setup. one week of bench time.
